memory_candidates.content: multi-task-creation-standard.md Component 4a step 1 currently instructs task creation to 'bias toward over-declaring (broader prefixes): false positives here only cost parallelism, not correctness.' This is a direct root cause of coarse whole-directory file_scope declarations later flagged by validate-state.sh Check 8 (added by task 61 specifically to catch this pattern) -- the standard that populates file_scope and the check that flags it are in tension. Any fix to coarse declarations should also update this guidance line, or new coarse declarations will keep being created.

Core scripts/tests/ follows a strong, near-universal test-<script-basename>.sh naming convention (verified: lint-*.sh <-> test-lint-*.sh, orchestrate-triage-classify.sh <-> test-orchestrate-triage-classify.sh, assess-repo-health.sh <-> test-assess-repo-health.sh). This convention is reliable enough to predict the exact test-file path for a not-yet-created implementation script at task-creation time, which resolves most 'unknown until research' file_scope cases for scripts/tests/ without needing to declare the whole directory.
